Run complete to the blueprint gate. Issue #6634 was driven as a feature run (`docs/features/bootstrap-worktree/`) via the autorun skill with `stop-after: decompose`; the breakdown is committed and `pr-body.md` sits current and uncommitted at the worktree root.

**Commits on `conductor/b20261014c-6634`** (all docs-only):
- `23c6c7597` — `autorun-brief.md` (with `stop-after: decompose`) + `idea.md`
- `a04a46855` — `prd.md` (PRD-1)
- `33af72ecb` — `architecture.md`
- `bb8d8ff93` — `breakdown.md` ← blueprint gate; loop stopped here per the brief

**Stage summary**
- **Idea** — grounded in measured evidence: the localization run (PR #6591) hit TS2307 on every `apps/hospitality` page in a fresh worktree even after `pnpm install`, and gotchas.md records missing-install as the #1 recurring agent failure. The protocol's work-in-flight / open-PR pre-flights **could not run** (no GitHub credential, `gh` forbidden) — recorded as such, with the Conductor owning batch-level checks.
- **PRD-1** — four requirements (idempotent command, pure core, hint-only hook, docs re-pointed), SC-1..SC-5 mapped from the issue's acceptance criteria; `ux: not-applicable` (dev tooling, no UI surface).
- **Architect** — node-builtins-only script so it runs pre-install; pure `decideBootstrapSteps` ordering install→build; dist-consumed packages **derived** from workspace entrypoints, never hardcoded; the hook shares the CLI's `--check` so "needs bootstrap" has one definition and the no-op path spawns nothing (that's what keeps the <5s criterion). No ADR consumed — nothing cleared the hard-to-reverse/surprising/trade-off bar, so ADR 89–91 stay unused.
- **Decompose** — five ordered items: WO-6 pure core TDD, WO-7 probes+CLI+script (SC-1/SC-2 proven in this very worktree), WO-8 SessionStart hook + wiring guards, WO-9 gotchas/worker-agent doc edits, WO-10 acceptance sweep. WO-11–15 unused.

**Aggregated assumptions** (all in artifact frontmatter): pre-flights unrunnable; stages run inline rather than one subagent each (this Worker's tool policy has no Agent tool; artifacts stayed the only inter-stage state); issue scope taken verbatim with no live Owner; mtime-receipt staleness over hashing; entrypoint-derived dist consumers; no tracker refs so nothing auto-closes #6634.

**Flagged for the Owner at the gate**: whether the entrypoint-derivation heuristic for "packages apps consume via dist/" matches intent (the alternative — the turbo graph — needs an install first), and that the hook deliberately never installs. Spend ended ~$5.9 of $6.44.
